> Auto-generated from 4 repositories · 2026-10-20

- **[jfrog-cli-core]** feat: add JFROG_CLI_CERTS_DIR env support [#1607](https://github.com/jfrog/jfrog-cli-core/pull/1607) (@andreasvikke)

### 🔧 Internal Changes

- **[jfrog-cli-security]** Addressed a gap in fully resolving the CVE-2026-92892 vulnerability in JFrog CLI v2.127.0.

- **[jfrog-cli-security]** Remove unzip/7z from the Advanced Security prerequisites check [#920](https://github.com/jfrog/jfrog-cli-security/pull/920) (@Jordanh1996)
- **[jfrog-cli-security]** XRAY-161169 - Normalization [#916](https://github.com/jfrog/jfrog-cli-security/pull/916) (@VidrevichMichael)
- **[jfrog-cli-security]** XRAY-161169 - Rename config entity [#921](https://github.com/jfrog/jfrog-cli-security/pull/921) (@VidrevichMichael)
